The racks are poorly designed with not enough prongs/racks. There is too much space in between the rows. Another thing is the control buttons on top of the door. Whenever the door is down, it is very easy to hit the operation buttons which will turn them on. The door is very light and appears cheaply made. The dishwasher doesn't leave the dishes dry unless you turn on the heated dry option, and even using it, the plastic items are still wet. My other dishwasher would somewhat dry the dishes without using the heated dry option. I do like that it is fairly quiet. I hope this review will help others and hopefully GE will reconsider the design.

Seriously, don't buy this piece of garbage. Whatever you have at the moment is better.

Sentence (English): We previously had an LG dishwasher that we purchased in 2015 and it was too costly to fix.
Comments (English): [ Louder than expected! ] || ---------------- || We previously had an LG dishwasher that we purchased in 2015 and it was too costly to fix. After being happy with LG appliances, we completed our research on all major dishwashers manufactures and choose this one. Our home has an open floor plan and based on the rating for noise, thought this was like one we had. Wrong! Upon our purchase we inquire about the noise, the sales rep stated we should only here it turn on. Wrong! It is very noisy and can here it from another room. We noticed the this dishwasher had less insulation on it, then our old dishwasher had. It does clean but we rinse off our dishes before we load them. If we would have known it was going to be this loud, we would had purchased a less expensive LG model. If you want something that does the job purchase a dishwasher that is less expensive. If you are looking for a quieter dishwasher purchase another model. Would not recommend.

Sentence (English): OMG what a faf!
Comments (English): [ What a Chalange! ] || ---------------- || OMG what a faf! We are an all Samsung House, TV's Fridge, Washer Dryer, etcWe just had a new kitchen and I wanted to replace the old inefficient Indesit Dishwasher with a new unit. So I asked the Samsung Chat person what the difference was between the as advertised on Samsung website "Built in" and "Built under", there is no "fully integrated" versions advertised. The agent was not able to understand my question even though they are terms on their own website. I had to download the "installation manual" to figure out that "Built in = fully Integrated and the BB at the end of the model number is an indication of that" So I ordered the unit and it arrived in two working days. That is where the fun realy started! The door template is exactly the same size as the dishwasher metal door, so you have to do some maths and add on a margin around the template to get it in the center of your custom door panel. This was extremely challenging to do as we are dealing with around 4mm to all sides around the template. When I finally twigged what the issue that the template was too small for the standard 60cm custom door panel, things became more clear, however the template fixing hole marks took some serious brain power for me, some were very obvious and some not so. Anyway some hours later I got to the point of installing the waste pipe, the anti syphon gismo is huge so I had to enlarge the apatue in adjacent cupboard where sink is.Note, the install manual advises the unit is not designed to have any electrical connections immediately behind the washer, there is virtually no clearance.Eventually the unit was installed and paired with smartthings, easy. I put the washer on a quick rinse to test connections and noted the blue "status lamp" shining on the floor, this lamp is just an "in use" indicator, I had to ping Samsung on that again as manual had no detail.Other than all that, my partner loves the top draw, and easy efficient draw moving levers, its very quiet and consuming a lot less energy than predecessor. It takes a bit of getting use to the oppen draw dry method, but that is where the true energy saving comes fromI do think the budget is a bit high in comparison, but hey im not washing the dishes!

Sentence (English): This was the worst nightmare!
Comments (English): [ Lemon - Out of the box failure within 65 days ] || ---------------- || This was the worst nightmare! Bought this unit from Costco.com with extended warranty through All State for a total of 5 years coverage on 10/17/2022. Delivered and installed 10/22/2022. Unit worked like a charm and we were pleased. But to our dismay, on Christmas Day with stacks of dinner plates, salad plates, wine glasses, serving dishes etc. the unit died. Everything had to be washed by hand. Contacted Whirlpool for Technical Support/ Customer Service. Was informed that Costco.com had mistakenly entered a purchase date of October 1, 2017. No way to confirm that Costco.com order entry made this error. But we gave Whirlpool the serial # and Model # via text photo to prove that this unit was not 5 years old. Whirlpool reluctantly scheduled 1-800Appliance to do the repair work on January 11, 2023. From Christmas Day until now, we've been washing dishes by hand for almost a month. Aggravating! On the day of the repair, I am notified by the repairman, on his way with 10 minutes out, that I need to show my Costco.com receipt with Model number to him, and call his office, so they can get paid for the repair. I produce my Costco.com order confirmation which lists the unit with a SKU number from Costco.com, not the Whirlpool model #. So the repairman is advised by his office not to do any work. He walks out. At this point my wife and I are totally irate and frustrated with this Costco.com/Whirlpool/1-800Appliance order debacle. Stephen Sondheim's ballad of "Send in the Clowns" comes to mind. No one stepped up to provide good customer service. All involved were incompetent, disingenuous and totally unprofessional. So as the Donald would say on the Apprentice: "You're fired". Unit is being picked up by Costco.com tomorrow. Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

Sentence (English): Problem with mine arose when the door seal trim came loose from the inner tub.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher, but mine broke after 2.5 years ] || ---------------- || Problem with mine arose when the door seal trim came loose from the inner tub. This trim is part of the inner tub (kind of riveted in place) and it runs up the left side, across the top and down the right side of the dishwasher. When the trim comes loose, it catches in the bottom drawer and the drawer no longer slides in and out. Mine, being loose up the left side, also no longer holds the rubber seal in place and the unit therefore leaks when in operation. Good news however, the Samsung warranty with this unit states that there is a "Lifetime warranty on the stainless door and tub for leakage"! Problem is, Samsung won't honor it. I've raised a claim with Samsung and they had me pay ($100) for a local repair company to come out, take pictures and send the info to Samsung, stating that the defect is part of the inner tub and cannot be repaired. Samsung replied to me that the unit is out of its 1 year warranty (now 2.5 years old) and that the warranty is therefore void. I explained to them what "lifetime" means as its read in the warranty manual that came with my unit - but they persist that there's nothing they can do. Why would they have me pay for a local repair shop to just tell me it's out of the 1 year warranty? They did state that as a courtesy, they'd send me $650+tx once they receive the original unit back. Not sure how that works, why they're offering me some money (when the unit sells for $999.99+tx) when the warranty states specifically that under the lifetime warranty for the stainless tub leaking (my specific defect) that I am supposed to receive a replacement unit of equal or greater value. Sorry to say, but the people I've been dealing with for the past 2 months are dishonest and will not honor their warranty as it reads. I escalated the issue as high as they transferred me, and they claim that once a "manager" makes a decision on how much they will settle the issue with me for, that they can do nothing more. Done with Samsung.

Sentence (English): When purchasing a dishwasher, I was deeply troubled by whether to buy the latest LG dishwasher with steam, hot air drying, and pause functions, or a cost-effective model that sticks to the basics.
Comments (English): [ Buy a dishwasher now! ] || ---------------- || When purchasing a dishwasher, I was deeply troubled by whether to buy the latest LG dishwasher with steam, hot air drying, and pause functions, or a cost-effective model that sticks to the basics. I worried I'd regret buying a more cost-effective option! But the bottom line is, I'm extremely satisfied with this value-for-money model! Personally, I didn't really need the steam or pause functions, and the lack of a hot air drying function is a bit disappointing, but it's still usable even without the drying function, so I'm not overly dissatisfied. Additional features include dual zones, spot washing, safe rinsing, high-temperature sterilization, high-temperature drying, and a timer. The DUBJ1E model features a touchscreen on the front, making it easy to press the cancel button and see the remaining time. Personally, I found it very convenient! One thing to note: Before pressing the start button, check that the blades under the second shelf aren't hitting anything. I've noticed that the lid locks for airtight containers in particular often come down and hit the handles. This is said to cause dishwasher malfunction. Be sure to check before pressing the start button. Hesitating to buy a dishwasher only wastes time; it's an appliance you absolutely must buy. I highly recommend it! Everyone, please buy it without hesitation. As an objet d'art, the design is incredibly pretty.

Comments (English): [ Great! When it's working ] || ---------------- || I had this dishwasher for about 3 weeks, and initially it was working amazingly! But slowly things started to change. Then they stopped getting clean. All of this over 3 weeks. I waited another 3 weeks for a technician to come out to diagnose the problem. He had never worked with one of these dishwashers so he wasn't sure what the problem was, but he ordered a few parts. I waited two more weeks for them to be installed. That was 6 days ago and it is working great again. Hopefully this will solve the problem, but I've had the dishwasher for 9 weeks and it's been usable for less than half of that time. So we'll see!

Sentence (English): I have wanted a Bosch dishwasher for a long time and am definitely disappointed.
Comments (English): [ Quality and performance are problems. ] || ---------------- || I have wanted a Bosch dishwasher for a long time and am definitely disappointed. I chose this model because I wanted controls on the front and the 3rd tray for large utensils. It washes well but does not dry well even when I use the additional hot dry option. BTW I always run the water until it is very hot before I start the cycle. There is often water on the inside of the door and on some of the items. I am not talking about water trapped in the top of overturned cups, but on the racks. Even though the directions tell you not to rinse, some residue is left on dishes. The next problem is that the soap dispenser is difficult to close. It eventually closes and I will call to have serviced.

Have been impressed that large bakeware items are completely clean despite having food baked on. The auto cycle might seem long for some but I let the machine have at it while I sleep. I use Cascade Platinum tabs with Jet Dry aid. It's a wonderful combination. While this machine is not inexpensive, it cleans so much better than the Electrolux. I recommend this product. If the drying aspect of the 800 is not important to you, a less expensive model should suit your needs

It was very easy to install, and it weighs almost nothing. The install kit that comes with it was great although the spring clamps for the drain hose needs to be replace with a radiator type clamp. Since I was putting the drain hose in the basement, I chose to use the radiator type clamp just to have peace of mind so I would not have to worry about a leak filling the basement with dishwater. The dishwasher was very easy to install and slid into the pre-existing opening like a glove. The hose for the water supply is a very high grade of hose and I have no doubt it will last quite some time. The installation is very straight forward and is very easy. This dishwasher is very quiet compared to the old one and it does a great job of cleaning the dishes and silverware. The controls are very user friendly, and my grandson is able to understand how to use it. The inside is quite spacious and allows a lot of dishes to be placed in to be cleaned. I highly recommend this dishwasher to anyone that is looking to replace an old one or to just have a new one. It is cost effective to use and will last a long time.

Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher that will even sanitize! ] || ---------------- || We really love how this dishwasher seamlessly fits into our white color kitchen. When closed, it looks like the rest of the cabinets, though the color is slightly darker. A lot of thought was put into the function and design of it. The fold down trays on top are perfect for small ramekins or other little containers, and the two separators on the bottom rack help to get your silverware cleaner. I also like that the silverware separators have large enough holes to fit wide ended forks and spoons, and are easily folded up and out of the way if you do not want to use them. The back of the front panel is stainless steel, which is a nice touch found in higher end machines. You have much more control over the cycles than a standard dishwasher, and there is even a sanitizing rinse option. Installation was very quick an easy (took me about 1.5 hours total, including removing the old one). All connections (water, drain, electrical), and adjustment for all four feet can be easily be reached from the front base panel. After that, simply install the two under counter brackets to hold it in place. As with all modern dishwashers, the cycles do take a while to run. The "quick wash" cycle took well over an hour, and the full normal with "heated dry, extended dry, sani rinse, and high temp" ran for about 3.5 hours. Both cycles thoroughly cleaned the dishes, though the second one did leave them dryer. All in all, for price, design, function, and beauty, this is a great machine that I expect will last for years to come!

Sentence (English): I come from a top of the range Bosch from 13 years ago (series 6) so my comparison is with that.
Comments (English): [ Material quality a step back ] || ---------------- || I come from a top of the range Bosch from 13 years ago (series 6) so my comparison is with that. On a technological level, it's certainly a big leap forward, the projection of the remaining washing time (or the end of the wash if you choose) is very nice, I also like being able to control it and above all being able to change the settings with an app. I don't like the white lighting but I preferred the blue one of the previous one, I don't even like the gradual switching on it gives me a sense of annoyance, I also hate the automatic shutdown of this one, in the middle of loading it turns off and it's not pleasant (maybe yes it could let the user decide the time or whether to leave it on. What however surprises me on the negative side is the quality of the materials, perhaps only apparent, but it seems like a step backwards, they are much lighter, perhaps they are better, but at least apparently they seem fragile and every time you pull out the baskets it seems like everything comes apart (especially the central one). The third drawer for cutlery is convenient, but on the other hand there is less space between the various baskets (this must be taken into consideration). It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

Comments (English): [ The product performance is good. Just think about two places to install it. ] || ---------------- || Please be aware that it may not be installed in the location you want, so think of one or two more possible installation locations in advance and proceed. It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. (적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. Just think about two places to install it. ] || ---------------- || Please be aware that it may not be installed in the location you want, so think of one or two more possible installation locations in advance and proceed. It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.
Comments (Original): [ 제품 성능은 좋아요. 설치 위치만 꼭 두곳 생각해두세요 ] || ---------------- || 내가 원하는 위치에 설치가 안될 수 있다는걸 꼭 알아두시고 미리 설치 위치 후보를 한 두곳 더 생각해두시고 진행하세요. 식기세척기가 싱크대를 지탱해주는 용도로 사용하기는 어렵기 때문에 싱크대의 지지하는 부분이 내가 설치하려는 부분과 겹친다면 그 부분에는 설치할 수가 없습니다.  싱크대 기준으로 왼쪽이냐 오른쪽이냐로 보통 고민하실텐데 기사님들은 보면 바로 딱 아시니 가능한 빠른 날짜에 사전방문을 받으셔서 설치 위치를 협의해서 공사를 진행하시길 바랍니다.  공사는 LG 공식업체인 판토스에서 진행하게 되고 코너장 절단 작업 등등 작업의 난이도에 따라 어떤 기사님은 작업이 불가능한 경우도 있습니다.  제 경우에는 가장 난이도가 높고 시간이 오래걸리는 작업인 코너장 절단 후 막아주고 그 옆쪽 장도 줄이는 공사를 거의 3시간 가까이 진행을 했습니다. 견적은 20만원 후반대였어요. (혹 외부업체로 시공하실 분들은 참고해보세요)  코너장 절단의 경우 장을 빼내서 밖으로 가져갈 수 없기 때문에 싱크대에서 그대로 작업을 하게되고 나머지 작업은 다 바깥(주로 복도)에서 작업을 하게됩니다.  아파트의 경우 복도 한켠에 목공소(?)처럼 테이블을 세우고 긴 전원케이블 선을 집에 연결해서 진행을 하시는듯 합니다. 상황마다 공간마다 다르겠지만 나무 자르는 소리가 거의 2시간 내외로 계속 복도에 난다고 생각하시고 준비하셔야 됩니다. (적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

(적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

Comments (English): [ The product performance is good. Just think about two places to install it. ] || ---------------- || Please be aware that it may not be installed in the location you want, so think of one or two more possible installation locations in advance and proceed. It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.

It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.
Comments (Original): [ 제품 성능은 좋아요. 설치 위치만 꼭 두곳 생각해두세요 ] || ---------------- || 내가 원하는 위치에 설치가 안될 수 있다는걸 꼭 알아두시고 미리 설치 위치 후보를 한 두곳 더 생각해두시고 진행하세요. 식기세척기가 싱크대를 지탱해주는 용도로 사용하기는 어렵기 때문에 싱크대의 지지하는 부분이 내가 설치하려는 부분과 겹친다면 그 부분에는 설치할 수가 없습니다.  싱크대 기준으로 왼쪽이냐 오른쪽이냐로 보통 고민하실텐데 기사님들은 보면 바로 딱 아시니 가능한 빠른 날짜에 사전방문을 받으셔서 설치 위치를 협의해서 공사를 진행하시길 바랍니다.  공사는 LG 공식업체인 판토스에서 진행하게 되고 코너장 절단 작업 등등 작업의 난이도에 따라 어떤 기사님은 작업이 불가능한 경우도 있습니다.  제 경우에는 가장 난이도가 높고 시간이 오래걸리는 작업인 코너장 절단 후 막아주고 그 옆쪽 장도 줄이는 공사를 거의 3시간 가까이 진행을 했습니다. 견적은 20만원 후반대였어요. (혹 외부업체로 시공하실 분들은 참고해보세요)  코너장 절단의 경우 장을 빼내서 밖으로 가져갈 수 없기 때문에 싱크대에서 그대로 작업을 하게되고 나머지 작업은 다 바깥(주로 복도)에서 작업을 하게됩니다.  아파트의 경우 복도 한켠에 목공소(?)처럼 테이블을 세우고 긴 전원케이블 선을 집에 연결해서 진행을 하시는듯 합니다. 상황마다 공간마다 다르겠지만 나무 자르는 소리가 거의 2시간 내외로 계속 복도에 난다고 생각하시고 준비하셔야 됩니다. (적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

(적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

Sentence (English): So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully.
Comments (English): [ The product performance is good. Just think about two places to install it. ] || ---------------- || Please be aware that it may not be installed in the location you want, so think of one or two more possible installation locations in advance and proceed. It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.

It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.
Comments (Original): [ 제품 성능은 좋아요. 설치 위치만 꼭 두곳 생각해두세요 ] || ---------------- || 내가 원하는 위치에 설치가 안될 수 있다는걸 꼭 알아두시고 미리 설치 위치 후보를 한 두곳 더 생각해두시고 진행하세요. 식기세척기가 싱크대를 지탱해주는 용도로 사용하기는 어렵기 때문에 싱크대의 지지하는 부분이 내가 설치하려는 부분과 겹친다면 그 부분에는 설치할 수가 없습니다.  싱크대 기준으로 왼쪽이냐 오른쪽이냐로 보통 고민하실텐데 기사님들은 보면 바로 딱 아시니 가능한 빠른 날짜에 사전방문을 받으셔서 설치 위치를 협의해서 공사를 진행하시길 바랍니다.  공사는 LG 공식업체인 판토스에서 진행하게 되고 코너장 절단 작업 등등 작업의 난이도에 따라 어떤 기사님은 작업이 불가능한 경우도 있습니다.  제 경우에는 가장 난이도가 높고 시간이 오래걸리는 작업인 코너장 절단 후 막아주고 그 옆쪽 장도 줄이는 공사를 거의 3시간 가까이 진행을 했습니다. 견적은 20만원 후반대였어요. (혹 외부업체로 시공하실 분들은 참고해보세요)  코너장 절단의 경우 장을 빼내서 밖으로 가져갈 수 없기 때문에 싱크대에서 그대로 작업을 하게되고 나머지 작업은 다 바깥(주로 복도)에서 작업을 하게됩니다.  아파트의 경우 복도 한켠에 목공소(?)처럼 테이블을 세우고 긴 전원케이블 선을 집에 연결해서 진행을 하시는듯 합니다. 상황마다 공간마다 다르겠지만 나무 자르는 소리가 거의 2시간 내외로 계속 복도에 난다고 생각하시고 준비하셔야 됩니다. (적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

(적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

Sentence (English): Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen.
Comments (English): [ The product performance is good. Just think about two places to install it. ] || ---------------- || Please be aware that it may not be installed in the location you want, so think of one or two more possible installation locations in advance and proceed. It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.

Just think about two places to install it. ] || ---------------- || Please be aware that it may not be installed in the location you want, so think of one or two more possible installation locations in advance and proceed. It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.
Comments (Original): [ 제품 성능은 좋아요. 설치 위치만 꼭 두곳 생각해두세요 ] || ---------------- || 내가 원하는 위치에 설치가 안될 수 있다는걸 꼭 알아두시고 미리 설치 위치 후보를 한 두곳 더 생각해두시고 진행하세요. 식기세척기가 싱크대를 지탱해주는 용도로 사용하기는 어렵기 때문에 싱크대의 지지하는 부분이 내가 설치하려는 부분과 겹친다면 그 부분에는 설치할 수가 없습니다.  싱크대 기준으로 왼쪽이냐 오른쪽이냐로 보통 고민하실텐데 기사님들은 보면 바로 딱 아시니 가능한 빠른 날짜에 사전방문을 받으셔서 설치 위치를 협의해서 공사를 진행하시길 바랍니다.  공사는 LG 공식업체인 판토스에서 진행하게 되고 코너장 절단 작업 등등 작업의 난이도에 따라 어떤 기사님은 작업이 불가능한 경우도 있습니다.  제 경우에는 가장 난이도가 높고 시간이 오래걸리는 작업인 코너장 절단 후 막아주고 그 옆쪽 장도 줄이는 공사를 거의 3시간 가까이 진행을 했습니다. 견적은 20만원 후반대였어요. (혹 외부업체로 시공하실 분들은 참고해보세요)  코너장 절단의 경우 장을 빼내서 밖으로 가져갈 수 없기 때문에 싱크대에서 그대로 작업을 하게되고 나머지 작업은 다 바깥(주로 복도)에서 작업을 하게됩니다.  아파트의 경우 복도 한켠에 목공소(?)처럼 테이블을 세우고 긴 전원케이블 선을 집에 연결해서 진행을 하시는듯 합니다. 상황마다 공간마다 다르겠지만 나무 자르는 소리가 거의 2시간 내외로 계속 복도에 난다고 생각하시고 준비하셔야 됩니다. (적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

(적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

Sentence (English): However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800.
Comments (English): [ The product performance is good. Just think about two places to install it. ] || ---------------- || Please be aware that it may not be installed in the location you want, so think of one or two more possible installation locations in advance and proceed. It is difficult to use the dishwasher to support the sink, so if the supporting part of the sink overlaps with the part you want to install, it cannot be installed in that area. You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. In my case, the most difficult and time-consuming work was cutting the corners, blocking them, and reducing the side walls, which took almost 3 hours. The estimate was in the late 200,000 won range. (If you are going to have an outside company do the work, please refer to this.) In the case of cutting the corners, since you cannot take the walls out and take them outside, the work is done on the sink as is, and the rest of the work is done outside (usually in the hallway). In the case of apartments, they set up a table in a corner of the hallway like a woodworking shop(?) and connect a long power cable to the house. It may vary depending on the situation and space, but you should prepare for the sound of cutting wood to continue in the hallway for about 2 hours. (If there are any piled up items, remove them and ask for the consent of the house in front or notify the management office, etc.) So, you should consider the noise time and plan the construction time carefully. After installing and using it, it feels like it has doubled compared to the 6-person room I used before. The washing power has also become much stronger, so it washes well. The noise is a bit loud when the dishes hit each other, but otherwise, it is really quiet. Since there is no separate locking device, I was worried that the kids might open it, but that didn't happen. On the contrary, because of the automatic drying function, if it is open, it tends to run and close it tightly as soon as it is seen, which causes a loss in drying. Usually, the standard mode is combined with the high-temperature drying mode, but in that case, hot steam comes out for a few minutes as soon as it is opened due to drying, so you have to be especially careful with children. I'll try out other additional items and post them later. PS I was contemplating between the Electrolux 800 model and the last one I bought, and I'm satisfied. However, if you have a bad back and need to be careful, consider comparing the Electrolux dishwasher model 800. PS The DUB line is a built-in model that can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The DFB line is a stand-alone model that can be installed only after cutting the mop holder. If you have to look into a built-in model, be sure to check if it starts with DUB before purchasing.

You will usually worry about whether it is to the left or right of the sink, but the technicians will know right away when they see it, so please visit in advance as soon as possible and discuss the installation location and proceed with the construction. The construction will be carried out by Pantos, an official LG company, and some technicians may not be able to do the work depending on the difficulty of the work, such as cutting the corners. (혹 외부업체로 시공하실 분들은 참고해보세요)  코너장 절단의 경우 장을 빼내서 밖으로 가져갈 수 없기 때문에 싱크대에서 그대로 작업을 하게되고 나머지 작업은 다 바깥(주로 복도)에서 작업을 하게됩니다.  아파트의 경우 복도 한켠에 목공소(?)처럼 테이블을 세우고 긴 전원케이블 선을 집에 연결해서 진행을 하시는듯 합니다. 상황마다 공간마다 다르겠지만 나무 자르는 소리가 거의 2시간 내외로 계속 복도에 난다고 생각하시고 준비하셔야 됩니다. (적치물건이 있다면 치우고 앞집에 양해 혹은 관리실에 말해두기 등등)  그래서 소음시간 등을 고려해서 공사 시간을 잘 잡아주셔야 할 듯 하네요. 설치 후 사용하면서 보니 기존에 쓰던 6인용 대비 2배 이상 늘어난 느낌이네요. 씻는 파워도 훨씬 쎄져서 깨끗하게 잘 닦이네요. 소음은 그릇들이 서로 부딪히게 뒀을 경우에는 소음이 좀 들리고 그렇지 않은 경우는 정말 조용합니다. 잠금장치 같은 것은 따로 없기 때문에 애들이 혹 열지 않을까 걱정했었는데 그런 일은 없네요. 오히려 자동건조 기능때문에 열려있으면 보이는 족족 달려와서 꼭꼭 닫아버려서 건조가 좀 손해보는 경향은 있네요 ㅎㅎ 보통 표준모드에 고온건조 모드를 조합해서 많이 쓰는데 그러면 건조 때문에 열리자마자 몇 분 정도는 뜨거운 김이 나오기 때문에 어린아이들은 각별하게 조심시키셔야 합니다. 다른 추가사항들은 더 사용해보고 올려볼게요. P.S. 마지막 구입전날까지도 일렉트로룩스 800 모델과 고민하다 구입했는데 만족합니다. 그래도 허리가 많이 안좋아서 조심하셔야 하는 분들은 일렉트로룩스 식기세척기 800 모델도 후보군에 놓고 비교해보세요.  P.S. DUB라인은 빌트인 모델로 걸레받이 절단없이 설치가 가능합니다. DFB라인은 스탠드형으로 걸레받이를 절단해야 설치가 가능하고요. 혹시라도 빌트인 모델 알아보셔야 하는 경우에는 DUB로 시작하는지 꼭 체크해보시고 구입하세요.

Sentence (English): I love the way this looks and the concept of it.
Comments (English): [ I wish this was a good product ] || ---------------- || I love the way this looks and the concept of it. Unfortunately, I don't think cafe was ready to release this product. I have had this installed in my home for a month now and have had nothing but problems. First the top drawer went out. The service tech that cafe hired in my area came out to fix it. He had no idea what was wrong just started taking things apart didn't see any issues, put it back together and it fixed. He said he had no idea what was wrong with it or what a future fix would be if we had gotten that error code again. Almost exactly one week later, the bottom drawer stops working. Service tech comes out (same guy who has never seen this dishwasher before) says the motor needs to be replaced on the dishwasher. We are running the dishwasher tabs in the silverware tray as suggested, running the recommended finish and filling as required. I'm not sure how the motor on a one month old dishwasher needs to be replaced already but the service technicians (not his fault) have never seen this dishwasher style before in my area. So he is blindly trying to fix a dishwasher. That just keeps on breaking for no apparent reason. This product needs more testing and people trained on it for repairs. By the time my dishwasher finally works properly I will need to supply this technician with room and board to fix issues that come up weekly. waste of time should have just bought the regular one. I would not recommend this product.

Sentence (English): We really like how this dishwasher looks.
Comments (English): We really like how this dishwasher looks. It is rated at 48 dba, and is much quieter than our last dishwasher. One thing I didn't expect was the long cycles. On our last dishwasher (about 15 years old), a normal cycle took about an hour. With this one cycles are usually double that amount of time. Since it's been so long since we had a new dishwasher, maybe this is normal. One thing our old dishwash had that I wish this one had was adjustable spokes on the bottom rack. The first row of spokes are spread apart so widely that it's hard to secure anything other than large dishes. I chose to install this myself. I've never installed a dishwasher before. Some of the instructions didn't make sense to me, so I had to resort to looking on YouTube for more information (specifically related to the trim pieces and sound dampeners). It took me a while, but I got it in there Ok. I think it was worth saving the almost $200 Home Depot would charge for installation. Overall, we are very happy with our new dishwasher, and hope it lasts us for many years.

Sentence (English): We bought this LG dishwasher along with an LG range and above-range convection microwave.
Comments (English): [ Good, quiet dishwasher with one caveat ] || ---------------- || We bought this LG dishwasher along with an LG range and above-range convection microwave. This dishwasher replaced an older KitchenAid that came with our house. We've generally been very happy with this dishwasher. It's quiet and it does a very good job cleaning dishes. The layout of the trays allows for you to put items into the dishwasher in the most optimum arrangement. It'd be nice if the plastics dried better, but no dishwasher I've encountered does a good job drying plastics. I also wish there were a couple other options for cycles. One thing I noticed is that you can completely lower all the dividers on the bottom tray, but on the upper tray, you can only lower half of the dividers. I'm not sure if other LG dishwashers allow you to lower all the dividers on the upper tray, but that's definitely something that would have been welcomed here. There's a third tray that sits at the top of the dishwasher that has proved very useful for various items, such as knives and the parts from a French press coffeemaker. My biggest complaint about this range is that the upper tray must be fully pushed in, otherwise the front door will not close fully. Even though the door doesn't close fully, the dishwasher can still run. In this situation, water will escape through the top through the opening between the door and the dishwasher's frame. This happened the first few times we used the dishwasher. We were actually fairly frustrated with that situation, especially given the amount of trouble the old dishwasher had given us. It was only upon further inspection that you have to fully push in the upper tray in order for the door to fully close and seal. The best layperson comparison I can make for how that top tray rolls in is that it's similar to some drawer sliders you might encounter on furniture, where you roll the drawer \"closed,\" but you need to physically push the drawer in for that last little bit. Upon doing so, you encounter a positive \"click\" that you can both feel and see as you close the drawer. It's the same thing here. The top tray \"clicks\" into a bracket on the inner back wall of the dishwasher. If you do not click the top tray into that, it's not fully rolled in, and thus the door will not fully seal. Why this is like this, I have no idea. I can't say I've encountered this on other past dishwashers, but we didn't look around at many others when buying this one for comparison purposes. It's really not a huge deal since we're used to it now, but this is an appliance that should be fully intuitive and easy-to-use. It generally is, but I can certainly see a situation where someone who doesn't live in the house or a child starts up a dishwasher cycle, not understanding that you have to fully push in that tray. You'll then be encountered with water all over your floor. The fact that the dishwasher's door sensor still considers the door \"closed\" in this situation is also somewhat puzzling. I assume that the sensor is associated with the latch, since the door can still latch, even if the door isn't fully sealed. Other than that issue, we are generally happy with this. It would be a five-star review if that top tray wasn't temperamental.

Sentence (English): Overall the dishwasher is good.
Comments (English): [ Good overall, but some awkward features ] || ---------------- || Overall the dishwasher is good. It is quiet and cleans well. I bought this to replace an older Gallery dishwasher. I miss being able to see how much time is left while the dishwasher is running. The controls give lots of options, which may or may not appeal, eg. you can select between three levels of water pressure for any wash cycle. Strangely, the "clean" light and green floor indicator come on after a rinse-only cycle, leaving no way for other family members to know that the dishes weren't fully washed. I like the third (top) shelf for utensils and cutlery. I find the bottom rack doesn't roll smoothly into the dishwasher, though. You have to align it just right for it to roll in without getting stuck. Rinse aid is essential, otherwise the plastic utensil rack at the top stays very wet and drips on everything else. Even with rinse aid, and on the heated dry cycle dishes often come out damp.

(2) I don't like the rack design as much as my old one, the dishes seemed to fit better in the rack in my old dishwasher. But maybe that's just me. Sentence (English): We bought this LG dishwasher along with an LG range and above-range convection microwave.
Comments (English): [ Good, quiet dishwasher with one caveat ] || ---------------- || We bought this LG dishwasher along with an LG range and above-range convection microwave. This dishwasher replaced an older KitchenAid that came with our house.We've generally been very happy with this dishwasher. It's quiet and it does a very good job cleaning dishes. The layout of the trays allows for you to put items into the dishwasher in the most optimum arrangement. It'd be nice if the plastics dried better, but no dishwasher I've encountered does a good job drying plastics. I also wish there were a couple other options for cycles.One thing I noticed is that you can completely lower all the dividers on the bottom tray, but on the upper tray, you can only lower half of the dividers. I'm not sure if other LG dishwashers allow you to lower all the dividers on the upper tray, but that's definitely something that would have been welcomed here. There's a third tray that sits at the top of the dishwasher that has proved very useful for various items, such as knives and the parts from a French press coffeemaker.My biggest complaint about this range is that the upper tray must be fully pushed in, otherwise the front door will not close fully. Even though the door doesn't close fully, the dishwasher can still run. In this situation, water will escape through the top through the opening between the door and the dishwasher's frame.This happened the first few times we used the dishwasher. We were actually fairly frustrated with that situation, especially given the amount of trouble the old dishwasher had given us. It was only upon further inspection that you have to fully push in the upper tray in order for the door to fully close and seal.The best layperson comparison I can make for how that top tray rolls in is that it's similar to some drawer sliders you might encounter on furniture, where you roll the drawer "closed," but you need to physically push the drawer in for that last little bit. Upon doing so, you encounter a positive "click" that you can both feel and see as you close the drawer.It's the same thing here. The top tray "clicks" into a bracket on the inner back wall of the dishwasher. If you do not click the top tray into that, it's not fully rolled in, and thus the door will not fully seal.Why this is like this, I have no idea. I can't say I've encountered this on other past dishwashers, but we didn't look around at many others when buying this one for comparison purposes. It's really not a huge deal since we're used to it now, but this is an appliance that should be fully intuitive and easy-to-use. It generally is, but I can certainly see a situation where someone who doesn't live in the house or a child starts up a dishwasher cycle, not understanding that you have to fully push in that tray. You'll then be encountered with water all over your floor.The fact that the dishwasher's door sensor still considers the door "closed" in this situation is also somewhat puzzling. I assume that the sensor is associated with the latch, since the door can still latch, even if the door isn't fully sealed.Other than that issue, we are generally happy with this. It would be a five-star review if that top tray wasn't temperamental.

Sentence (English): I saw a very cost-effective dishwasher on ~, and I bought it without waiting for a good price.
Comments (English): I saw a very cost-effective dishwasher on ~, and I bought it without waiting for a good price. There was a dent on the back when it was delivered, and I called the official customer service to deal with it in time. The first time I used it, I didn't cover the dishwashing salt. I was afraid of problems and kept asking the customer service. The customer service answered them patiently. After using it a few times, I feel that this size pot is just suitable for a family of two. It can be placed more casually and washed relatively clean, but there will be rice grains on the rice spoon that have not been rinsed. After drying, the bowl is basically dry, but after washing Some drops of water remain on the bottom of the bowl machine. Generally speaking, the price/performance ratio is very high, and the washing effect is also good. If the budget is limited and there are only two or three people in the family, this dishwasher can be used
Comments (Original): 在~上看到的性价比很高的一款洗碗机，一直没有等到好价就直接入手了。送到的时候背部有凹陷，打官方客服的电话及时处理了。第一次使用没把洗碗盐的盖子盖上，害怕出问题一直问客服，客服都解答的很耐心。用了几次感觉这个大小放个锅刚好适合两口之家，可以放的比较随意，洗的比较干净，但是像饭勺上也会有饭粒没有冲洗干净，烘干后碗基本干了，但是洗碗机底部还残留一些水珠。总体来说，性价比很高，洗完效果也不错，要是预算有限，家里就两三个人，这款洗碗机可以入手

It's perfect, freeing my hands, and finally I don't have to wash in the kitchen all the time. My mother also said that this high technology is really good. Sentence (English): I had a Bosch 800 series at my old house.
Comments (English): [ Love this dishwasher but Cystaldry is not worth it ] || ---------------- || I had a Bosch 800 series at my old house. It was a great dishwasher and I LOVED having the third rack. When I moved, my new house had a Thermador dishwasher. It was decent but the big problem was that it had no third rack. So I bought a new Bosch 800 series to replace it. LOVE how quiet it is and how adjustable all the racks are. But I sprung the extra couple hundred bucks for the CrystalDry, and I really don't think it was worth it. Plastic still doesn't dry all the way. Sure, it may be dryer than it would be without CrystalDry, but I still have to spend time wiping stuff with a towel. It's disappointing. And the red digital display is usually flashing between loads, unless I remember to hit the ON/OFF button, which is slightly annoying. Also, the top rack is a little tighter than the Thermador so it doesn't accommodate as many items. Luckily, the third rack makes up for that!

Sentence (English): I'd expected better build quality at the price.
Comments (English):
[ Not good enough for the price! ] || ---------------- || I'd expected better build quality at the price. I think Bosch can do much better.

The reduction in noise on regular wash cycles in comparison to the 12 year old cheap and cheerful model it replaces is negligible. On the control panel, light bleeds from one button to those next to it. When depressing a button, those directly next to it flex and move also. In general, the buttons feel cheap and not long lasting. When opening the door, the mechanism has an irritating rattle from new. The height of the unit is very short in comparison to standard UK work top heights meaning it will need to be raised up via additional floor boards or timber so it can be mounted pressed up to the bottom of the work top surface. The feet don't actually extend enough to accomplish this. There's two issues because of this, firstly, the projected image onto the floor during operation looks fuzzy and lacks definition because its out of focus (the capability to adjust this would have been useful) and secondly a lot of space that could actually be utilised for larger internal area is just wasted. The accompanying installation instructions are difficult to understand and make what's quite a simple task unnecessarily hard. I found someone's Youtube video a lot more useful.

It seems to wash better than the model it replaced though. As it stands, I wouldn't recommend anyone buys this. It's well overpriced and the build quality is below par for a machine of this cost.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher may be Haier's cheapest 13-set freestanding dishwasher.
Comments (English): This dishwasher may be Haier's cheapest 13-set freestanding dishwasher. Due to the limited location, there is no choice for dishwashers with hot air drying or automatic door opening technology. This dishwasher is still the traditional 850 high body, with two layers of bowls, 13 sets of capacity, all-metal inner cavity, three sets of spray arms, supports Haier's 80°C technology, and other conventional functions (such as no 1 /2 wash, no 80°C technique). The disadvantage is that compared with the 15 sets, there is one less layer of bowl basket, and the bowl basket brackets are all fixed and cannot be adjusted; it does not support the automatic door opening and drying that Haier mainly promotes; the water efficiency level is only four, and the energy consumption is relatively high.

Sentence (English): If you are looking for a dishwasher that has everything crooked and crooked and you want to see a whole host of manufacturing flaws in a single unit, this unit would be a good choice.
Comments (English): [ Very poor workmanship - expected more for the money! ] || ---------------- || If you are looking for a dishwasher that has everything crooked and crooked and you want to see a whole host of manufacturing flaws in a single unit, this unit would be a good choice. In view of the fact that several specimens have such poor processing characteristics, it is remarkable that this model of all things should be the test winner at Stiftung Warentest. We had this device replaced several times and each time the paint on the lower left area next to the hinge peeled off. Corrosion is foreseeable here and the manufacturer says when asked that the damage is only minor and acceptable. Apparently you can't expect the door to be mounted straight for 800 euros. The front panel also protrudes on one side. Siemens quality made in Poland.
Comments (Original): [ Sehr schlechte Verarbeitung - für das Geld mehr erwartet! ] || ---------------- || Wenn Sie einen Geschirrspüler suchen bei dem alles schief und krumm zusammengebaut ist und sie eine ganze Reihe von Produktionsfehlern an einem einzigen Gerät sehen möchten, wäre dieses Gerät eine gute Wahl. Es ist in Anbetracht der Tatsache, dass gleich mehrere Exemplare so schlechte Verarbeitungsmerkmale aufweisen bemerkenswert, dass ausgerechnet dieses Modell bei Stiftung Warentest Testsieger sein sollte. Wir haben dieses Gerät mehrfach austauschen lassen und jedes mal blätterte der Lack am linken unteren Bereich neben dem Scharnier ab. Hier ist Korrosion vorhersehbar und der Hersteller sagt auf Nachfrage, dass es nur geringfügige, hinzunehmende Schäden handelt. Offenbar kann man für 800 Euro nicht erwarten, dass die Türe gerade montiert ist. Auch die Frontblende steht auf einer Seite vor. Siemens Qualität made in Poland...

Aún tengo que hacerme con todas las funciones para sacarle el máximo partido al aparato.Empiezo con las COSAS POSITIVAS:Vairedad de funciones (programa Eco, automatico, mediacarga, lavados más cortos,...).La función de puerta abierta para que deje salir el vapor despues del secado, es lo más queda todo bastante seco.Respecto a la bandeja superior para los cubiertos, no estaba muy convencida al principio (estaba acostumbrada a típica cesta que tenía el antiguo) pero tengo que decir que me está ganando, caben los cuchillos grandes, alguna espátula y los cubiertos quedan muy limpios, y por supueto libera espacio de la inferior.Tiene conexión con una APP que te permite configurar los programas y funciones y cosas extras que tienen muy buena pinta.Tiene un programa para limpiar el aparato, aun no la probé pero seguro que lo deja reluciente.La vajilla me sale super limpia, estoy muy contentaEste aparato es de eficiencia energetica C,  eso es un plus, ya que consume menos que el que tenia antes.Respecto a los CONTRAS: que no meta los platos solo en el lavavajillas, no es broma ;)... ahora en serio yo no le veo contras.Estoy muy contenta con mi compra me facilita el día a día en casa, espero que me dure mucho tiempo y que todo siga bien.
